P3:P3F_agem_verdict_short: improved on it significantly on TON-IoT and N-BaIoT, closing at most 57% of the gap
P3:P3F_agem_mechanism: Used only to constrain the gradient direction, the memory recovered a sizeable part of what replay recovers on TON-IoT and N-BaIoT, but far less on UNSW-NB15; on N-BaIoT the seeds ranged from 0.319 to 0.809.
P3:P3F_orders_agem_sentence: Replay also beat A-GEM in every order.
P3:P3F_er2000p_shortfall_verdict: The newest-task shortfall shrank by more than half on all three datasets; at least one earlier task now fell as far below the joint level as the newest task, or further, on all three datasets (TON-IoT Task 0: 0.900 against 0.967; UNSW-NB15 Task 1: 0.611 against 0.635; N-BaIoT Task 1: 0.755 against 0.997), so the location of the shortfall depends partly on the double weighting.
P3:P3F_rfmem_verdict: better than the CNN with ER-2000 on all three datasets, but worse than the CNN with ER-2000-pool on UNSW-NB15
P3:P3F_rfmem_advice: A random forest retrained on the same memory had a higher macro-F1 and a lower benign FPR than the CNN with ER-2000 on all three datasets; on UNSW-NB15 the CNN with ER-2000-pool had the higher macro-F1, and the forest flagged only 0.702 of the earlier attack records, against 0.999 for that network. Where a tree model fits the deployment, it is a strong alternative to a continually trained network and should be the reference any such network is compared with.

P5:ls_conclusion: SHAP's lead in the deletion test therefore does not depend on LIME's kernel width or representation.
P5:pos_conclusion: Ranking by sign does not reverse the comparison in any combination.
P5:TON_mcn_conclusion: Pooled over seeds the counterfactuals beat the benign-donor control on UNSW-NB15, but per seed the difference is significant in 2 of 3 seeds, so it should be read as a consistent tendency rather than a robust per-model effect.
P5:UNSW_mcn_conclusion: With the pairing used, the counterfactuals beat the benign-donor control in every seed on UNSW-NB15.
P5:hp_note: These tests come from a second run of the hardening experiment with the same seeds, which stores the per-record outcomes; it reproduces the evasion rates above for the original and counterfactual models exactly, and those of the two controls to within 0.7 points.
